methods.what: Table of the powers of the primitive root 3 modulo 17, each paired with its least residue modulo the Gaussian prime 1+4i (norm 17), using i ≡ 4 (mod 1+4i)
Linear interpolation: the ordinate at abscissa [a+m] on the line through the points (a,b) and (a',b'), i.e. through a+bi and a'+b'i
Geometric representation of the residues modulo a Gaussian integer as lattice points inside a tilted square in the integer lattice
